$comment: Reference repositories cloned into repos/<name> by scripts/vendor-repos.ts (postinstall). Add an entry like {"effect": {"url": "https://github.com/Effect-TS/effect.git", "ref": "effect@{version:effect}"}}. {version:<pkg>} expands to the version of <pkg> pinned in the root catalog or in a workspace package.json; a plain tag such as "v1.2.3" works too.
